title: Heads regroup values without moving them
purpose: A canonical flat vector [4] becomes [2,2]; head coordinates map to the same four elements.
contract: No arithmetic, allocation or transpose is implied by this view
caption: A canonical flat vector [4] becomes [2,2]; head coordinates map to the same four elements. D = 4, H = 2, Dₕ = 2. offset(h,j) = h × 2 + j. No arithmetic, allocation or transpose is implied by this view.
